title: אבא סמוקיד
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Abba Samukid: R. Berekhya son of R. Ḥelbo in his name, Bamidbar Rabbah 3. Mattenot Kehunah explains that this is his name. Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of HaRo'eh, has R. Berekhya and R. Ḥelbo in R. Abba Samuka's name. Perhaps one passage has a scribal error.
